package collector

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

// A decoder of another package handed a file opened without os.Open.
func PinEvasionYAMLFILE(dir string) int {
	f, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Join(dir, "sub"), "pnpm-lock.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	var v map[string]any
	_ = yaml.NewDecoder(f).Decode(&v)
	return len(v)
}
